return_basis: close-to-close on SPLIT AND DIVIDEND ADJUSTED closes (adjustment=all), which approximates TOTAL return. It is NOT the same construction as the CRSP/Fama-French pinned vintage and must not be mixed into one table with it.
why: learner/benchmark.py has no small-cap id and its SPY/QQQ paths require network and refuse offline. Two lanes on 2026-09-08 needed a small-cap ruler and could not get one.
not_registered: Deliberately NOT added to benchmark.REGISTRY. Registration needs a network-free guarantee, a hash gate and tests -- that is a lane, not a side effect of a measurement.
caveats: An ETF's adjusted close is not an index total return: it carries tracking error, fees and the fund's own dividend timing.
The SIP feed is the consolidated tape for HISTORICAL bars; the IEX feed would be roughly 2-4% of consolidated volume and a different market.
This is a VENDOR series pulled today, not a hash-gated academic vintage. A claim for export should still be graded against the pinned CRSP market.
No survivorship question arises for these four ETFs over this window, but the window starts 2015 and says nothing about earlier regimes.
